title: Set aside (duplicate pair): Triglycerides and coronary heart disease: the Reykjavik cohort estimate (restated)
explanation: Claim A finds a significant positive association between triglyceride levels and coronary heart disease risk after adjustment, whereas Claim B finds no significant association.
a_text: In the Reykjavik study, the adjusted odds ratio for coronary heart disease comparing the top third with the bottom third of usual log-triglyceride values is 1.76 (95% CI, 1.39 to 2.21).
b_text: Triglyceride level is not significantly associated with coronary heart disease risk after adjustment for conventional risk factors (HR 0.99 per 1-SD higher value).
